resolution: Crash fix for the wgpu SIGABRT the round-1 asset dock introduced. Root cause: AssetPreview caches each material preview in a StaticSurface keyed per asset with exactly one pixel size, and the new detail card mounted those same keys at 64x64 while the material grid tiles mount them at 68x68 — the cache resize under a queued capture pass left a 68x68 scissor rect against the re-allocated 64x64 render target, which is a wgpu validation error that wgpu-native escalates to a process abort (same family as the req_2743 bind-group note in AssetPreview). Fix: the detail-card thumb is now 68x68 so every persistent cached mount agrees on one size, with the constraint documented on HW_DetailThumb; audited all AssetPreview mounts — the only other consumer (world quick menu) already uses live uncached previews. Bundle-verified; relaunch the dev host to pick it up.
